recognize_zh: 冠狀切面腹部電腦斷層（CT）顯示脾臟極度腫大，從左上腹一路延伸越過中線、下達骨盆腔，把腸道推擠到右側與下方，肝臟亦明顯腫大，符合骨髓纖維化的巨脾（髓外造血）。
features: Coronal contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis
Massively enlarged spleen extending from the left upper quadrant across the midline into the pelvis
Homogeneous splenic parenchymal enhancement without discrete focal lesions
Hepatomegaly with bowel loops displaced to the right lower abdomen
No morphologic (microscopic) information; imaging supports but does not establish the diagnosis
describe_en: Coronal contrast-enhanced CT image demonstrates massive splenomegaly, with the spleen extending across the midline and into the pelvis and displacing bowel loops to the right and inferiorly. The splenic parenchyma is homogeneous without focal masses or infarcts evident on this single slice, and the liver is also enlarged. Massive splenomegaly of this degree is consistent with extramedullary hematopoiesis in primary myelofibrosis, though the imaging appearance itself is nonspecific.

ddx.vs: Can cause identical massive splenomegaly; distinguished by marked leukocytosis with basophilia and BCR::ABL1 on molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or splenic marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: Also cause massive splenomegaly, but diagnosis rests on blood/marrow morphology and flow cytometry (CD25/CD103/CD11c or clonal B cells) rather than imaging.
Spleen may contain focal hypoechoic/hypodense Gaucher nodules or infarcts, with Gaucher cells in marrow and low glucocerebrosidase activity.
Distinguished clinically and by amastigotes in marrow macrophages or by hemoglobin analysis, not by splenic CT appearance.
